$comment: v0.50 editor UX contract. Metric keys are `viewport/document/subject/metric`, measured by scripts/editor-ux/measure.mjs on the production web build in Chromium. `budgets` are the normative limits; `deterministic` budgets do not depend on machine speed; the others are latency budgets in reference-machine milliseconds (see `calibration`). `exceptions` are temporary ceilings for metrics that do not meet their budget yet: each names the delivery issue that removes it. `npm run ux:gate` builds, measures, and fails on any violation of this file. Change budgets or exceptions only through one reviewed update to this file and editor-ux-baseline.md.

calibration.$comment: referenceMs: duration of the fixed Canvas 2D calibration workload on the v0.49.0 baseline run (GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, 4 CPUs). Latency metrics are scaled by referenceMs / measured calibration before they are checked, so budgets are in reference-machine milliseconds. dragFloorMs: the 20-step drag loop with nothing on the main thread, one step per 60 Hz frame. slider-drag/durationMs is reported as dragFloorMs plus the scaled time above the floor measured on the same machine, because the floor follows frame pacing (665.7 ms on the CI runner, 333 ms on macOS) rather than CPU speed.

fixed.reason: Preview renders are latest-wins with a cooldown during continuous input, GPU readback no longer blocks the main thread, and slider drags use a gesture draft.
Node thumbnails reuse unchanged upstream branches through a content-addressed graph cache, and the selected and output previews queue without a debounce.

exceptions.reason: Selecting a layer opens the inspector column, moves the preview 170 px left, and narrows the command bar by 340 px.
Entering Nodes replaces the full-width command bar with a narrower one at a different position.
The command bar changes position and width between Layers and Nodes.
Returning to Layers re-lays out the canvas area and the command bar.
The command bar changes position and width between Nodes and Layers.
Nodes opens at a fixed zoom instead of fitting the graph: 5 of 7 nodes start outside the viewport.
Nodes opens at a fixed zoom instead of fitting the graph: 7 of 9 nodes start outside the viewport.
Randomize is covered by More at 375 px.
Randomize overlaps More and Projects at 375 px.
After visiting Nodes, the Layers inspector renders the same slider at 129 px instead of 168.5 px.
After visiting Nodes, the Layers inspector renders the same slider at 129 px instead of 357 px.
The preview render starts within 10 ms of the key, but one GPU effect pass takes about 50 ms on the CI runner, so the first paint lands at 65-86 ms.
The render above the edited layer runs two GPU effect passes of about 50 ms each on the CI runner, so the first paint lands at 120-150 ms.
